model.admission: Perceived empty supported spawn within120ft and LoE; nominated faction stable ID is known to caster. NEW invocation predicate: caster is a recorded member, current standing >=+1, and an explicit invocationPermission record is active. These are test fixtures here, never inferred from class access or copied from Ally/Champion.
model.factionInput: A versioned faction-power registration selects one of the two new spell-owned profiles below. The synthetic faction records TEST-DD11-WARDENS and TEST-DD11-COURIERS authorize these profiles only in static fixtures. No real institution, leader, memory, treasury or magical permission is created.

body.anatomy: two legs, two hands, head; physical solid body
body.saves: owner proficiency bonus as the explicit ordinary-summon default; no additional ability modifier
body.language: understands owner commands; no institution knowledge or ungranted language
body.gear: none at creation; attack is intrinsic; a real borrowed item remains real and separately owned

strike.cost: one commanded damaging Action, shared owner offense allowance
strike.target: one perceived creature at5ft, clear LoE

guard.effect: +2 typed Incarnate AC until next owner regular START or source ending, whichever first; no concentration, no HP gain
guard.stacking: strongest same-stat flat bonus rule, no stacking duplicate

carryOrHandoff.cost: ordinary actual item-handling Action in attached phase, under command
carryOrHandoff.limits: hands,200lb/10Load, reach5ft, real source item custody/weight; never automatic pickup at summon

TEST-DD11-COURIERS.tradeoff: no guard action; movement remains supported physical walking, not flight/teleportation

model.command: Owner spends real Bonus Action within60ft and perceived by companion. Consume owner companionCommandRound at commitment; execution occurs only in the attached phase after the complete owner turn. Consume companionOffenseRound only for damaging action execution. Clear pendingCommand on the attempt and retain consumed receipt; never replay a cancelled/attempted order. No independent regular turn or free Reaction.
model.default: No valid command: supported movement up to current budget and Dodge only. The fixture chooses zero movement and Dodge when already supported. No offensive guard/strike/item transfer as an uncommanded action.
model.healingAndDeath: NEW profile binding: this living Elemental can receive an ordinary HP-healing source only if that actual source allows Elementals/summons; no special named AC5 permission imported. Clamp to100, preserve injuries/deadlines. Ordinary0HP or a qualifying source-authorized terminal Null outcome ends existence; no reusable corpse, loot or death-resource proc. Bind actual healing/Null provider if the test claims that provider activation.

lifecycle.standingLoss: standing below+1 or membership lost cancels queued command and denies new commands; body remains default until original deadline unless invocation permission itself is revoked
lifecycle.permissionRevocation: ends manifestation immediately; no source refund
lifecycle.suppression: body and source traits suppressed according to provider locus; no orders while unavailable; deadline keeps running; resume cannot restore cancelled command
lifecycle.recast: new successful source replaces prior body, settles real cargo once and does not reset owner-round budgets
lifecycle.ending: intrinsic body/force strike ends; real cargo drops at current exact bounds and follows real support/fall settlement; guard ends, source IDs retained in history

steps: Attempt another companion offense in same owner round
